Isaiah 48:17b MSG
…”I am God, your God, who teaches you how to live right and well. I show you what to do, where to go.

We all need direction & superior knowledge which God alone has.

?
??In Genesis 30, we saw this playing out. God showed Jacob what to do while he was with Laban & because God was involved, his prosperity was unprecedented. Laban himself was compelled to acknowledge this divine prosperity..

??This month, God will show you what to do & where to go.✔

??The information you need to make progress will get to you effortlessly. ✔

??The strategy you need to breakthrough will be given to you from above.

This month, you will have resounding successes in all your endeavors in Jesus name ????
